content.text:
Due dates are done:

- `Task.dueAt?: number` on the core type
- `store.setDueDate(id, dueAt)` to set or clear one
- `store.isOverdue(task)` — true only when a due date is in the past and the task isn't complete

I wrote `src/state/dueDates.test.ts` covering four cases: past due, future due, completed-and-past, and no due date at all. All tests pass ✅

The overdue indicator can now key off `store.isOverdue(task)` in the render layer.
